strengths.quote: I called at nine and somebody was at the house by two. Nobody else did that.
He left me the number in writing and said take your time. I liked that.

strengths.theme: Crew showed up on the day promised
strengths.quote: My neighbor used someone else and waited three weeks. You were here Tuesday like you said.
The monthly payment was on the first page. That made it easy to say yes.
The ten year warranty is what got my husband on board.

weaknesses.theme: Price shock on the first quote
weaknesses.quote: I did not expect it to be that much. I thought it would be half.

weaknesses.theme: Hard to reach the office after five
weaknesses.quote: I tried calling back last night and it just rang.
Between eight and noon is a big window to wait around the house.
Does that price include removing the old windows? Nobody said.

weaknesses.theme: Slow to send the written proposal
weaknesses.quote: He said I would have it that day and it came two days later.

opportunities.quote: Do you do payments? I would do it this year if I could spread it out.
We had the hail last week and the insurance adjuster said to get quotes.
Three houses on our street have your signs up, so I figured I should call.

opportunities.theme: Interest in bundling roof and gutters
opportunities.quote: If we are doing the roof anyway, can the gutters go on at the same time?
Mi mamá prefiere hablar en español, ¿tienen alguien?

threats.quote: Another company came in about twelve percent under you for the same windows.
A guy knocked on the door after the storm and wanted a deposit today.
The home center said they could install it for less, so why should I pay you?

threats.theme: Rising material costs in the news
threats.quote: I read prices are going up again, so I am wondering if I should wait.

threats.theme: Review scores on a competitor's page
threats.quote: Their page has a lot more reviews than yours does.

objections.text: I need to talk to my spouse
objections.rebuttal: Offer a two-person estimate time and send the written summary to both of them the same day.

objections.text: The price is higher than I expected
objections.rebuttal: Lead with the monthly payment, then show what the price includes line by line.

objections.text: I want to get a few more quotes
objections.rebuttal: Agree, then give the three questions to ask every contractor, including warranty terms.

objections.text: I am not ready to do it this year
objections.rebuttal: Name the cost of waiting for this specific home and book a follow-up date.

objections.text: Can you do it cheaper if I pay cash?
objections.rebuttal: Explain the one standard price and the written guarantee that comes with it.

objections.text: I had a bad experience with a contractor before
objections.rebuttal: Acknowledge it, then walk through who is on the crew and how the job is checked at the end.
